record.title: Aqina trade disruption with reported Taliban access-road blockade

record.enforcement: Council secretary reports road obstruction; separate officials describe staff absence. No verified order closing the international gate.
record.consequences: Local traders report fuel-price increases; causality not independently quantified.

record.official_rationale: Provincial officials attribute trade interruption to fighting and Taliban road obstruction; no Taliban closure rationale independently established.
record.context: Late-June trade cessation reported during security collapse; that timing does not establish the onset of the specific deliberate cargo-road obstruction.
record.uncertainty: Dari source recovered; access obstruction remains attributed to a named provincial official. Onset, clearance, precise roadblock location and independent corroboration remain missing.
